whatsNew.title: What Changes from 2025–26?
whatsNew.subtitle: Meaningful differences between the two official Student Calendars
content: The first day moves from August 4 to August 3, and the last day moves from May 21 to May 20.
The published student-day total increases from 175 to 176; the second semester grows from 88 days to 89.
Fall Break expands from October 13–17 in 2025–26 to October 12–19 in 2026–27, while Spring Break II moves from April 3–6 to March 26 and 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When does MSCS start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The current Student Calendar lists Monday, August 3, 2026, as the first day for students. The source is pending Tennessee Department of Education approval.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MSCS Fall Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students are out October 12–19, 2026, and return Tuesday, October 20. The Teacher Calendar identifies October 19 as a district learning day for teacher inservice.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MSCS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is MSCS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The main Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027. MSCS also lists Spring Break II on March 26 and 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Are MSCS parent-conference dates no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No, not according to the districtwide Student Calendar. MSCS lists separate high, middle and elementary conference evenings from 4–7 p.m. without marking those dates as student holidays.
The current PDF is published by MSCS but says it is pending Tennessee Department of Education approval. Check the official calendar page again before making firm plans.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 20, 2026 against the current MSCS Student Calendar, Teacher Calendar, Attendance and Report Card Periods, Assessment Calendar, and Spanish Student Calendar.
sourceReviewDetails: August 3, May 20, all published breaks, six 4–7 p.m. conference evenings, semester exams and the approval notice were checked against the official Student Calendar.
The Teacher Calendar was used only to explain staff activity during student breaks; it does not replace the Student Calendar for attendance.
The Attendance and Report Card Periods file lists 49, 38, 47 and 42 quarter days, for 87 first-semester days, 89 second-semester days and 176 total days.
The Spanish Student Calendar contains the same student schedule in Spanish, not a separate academic track.
The Assessment Calendar is linked for district and state testing windows; assessment dates are not included in the student ICS.
sourceMaintainerText: Memphis-Shelby County Schools. MySchoolDates independently reviewed the calendar data against MSCS publications.
